messages.subject: RKWard 0.7.0 Crashing
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I have recently installed RKWard due to a need in my institution, and I am coming across a problem with the application, RKWard crashes as soon as it opens.

Upon installation, I realized that the version of R used was much earlier than what I needed (which is ver 3.4.3) and when I did install and change the directory to it via the rkward.ini file this problem occured.

This was the same on the earlier version of RKWard.

Is this a common issue and would you have a solution to this?

Kind Regards,
Kenji

messages.subject: RKWard 0.7.0 Crashing
messages.body_plain:
dear kenji,

Am Donnerstag, 11. Januar 2018, 14:26:51 CET schrieb 
kenjisato1996 at yahoo.co.jp:
> Upon installation, I realized that the version of R used was much earlier
> than what I needed (which is ver 3.4.3) and when I did install and change
> the directory to it via the rkward.ini file this problem occured.

i take it you're running RKWard on windows. RKWard needs the R version it was 
compiled with to work correctly. it is usually possible to do point release 
upgrades of R (like using 3.4.3 instead of 3.4.2), but since R sometimes 
changes fundamentally between even minor (3.3 vs. 3.4) upgrades, you need to 
use the version that RKWard expects.

i think the latest 0.7.0 windows build was done with R 3.3. if you're lucky 
thomas could possibly build a more recent snapshot.


viele grüße :: m.eik
